items.title: Gurugram hit and run: Court remands accused Kalyan Bainsla to 14 days judicial custody
items.summary: A Gurugram court on Friday remanded Kalyan Bainsla, the driver accused of hitting a woman biker, and co-accused Lavneesh, to judicial custody for 14 days. Judicial Magistrate Ist Class (JMIC) Nidhi Beniwal passed the order after the police custody of the accused ended. They had earlier been remanded to the custody of Gururgam Police on Wednesday for two days following their arrest from Rajasthan on Tuesday. The accused have been arrested in a case registered by the Sector 55/56 Police Station under Sections 109 (attempt to murder), 281 (rash driving) and 125 (act endangering life or personal safety of others) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The police have also invoked Section 78 (stalking) and 79 (word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman) of the BNS against them. The case was registered after the victim, Shivani Chauhan, posted a video on social media on Sunday showing a vehicle allegedly driven by Bainsla, a gym owner, speeding towards her and hitting her bike on the Golf Course Road.
